subject.title: Session Routing Bugs: CLI routing to wrong session, WeChat ID inconsistency, and session deadlock from message flooding

question: Should maintainers split issue #88204 into separate canonical work items for TUI default sessions, Weixin identity routing, background-event isolation, and session activity ordering, or close it after the partial merged fixes?
rationale: Current main proves partial fixes but the remaining behavior crosses TUI defaults, external WeChat plugin ownership, session storage/UI semantics, and agent background-event policy, so automation cannot safely choose the product boundary.

options.title: Split and keep canonical work
options.body: Keep this open or replace it with focused linked issues for the still-missing surfaces while recording #90231 and #93686 as partial fixes.

options.title: Close after partial fixes
options.body: Close only if maintainers decide the remaining reports are obsolete or unsupported and point users to new focused reproductions.

options.title: Plugin-first WeChat triage
options.body: Route the WeChat identity portion to the external Weixin plugin owner while retaining core issues for TUI/session activity and background-event isolation.

recommendation.title: Split and keep canonical work
recommendation.body: Keep this open or replace it with focused linked issues for the still-missing surfaces while recording #90231 and #93686 as partial fixes.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored both merged routing changes closest to the current source behavior and can best identify what remains after those fixes.
